spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (घुरति)
1 To be frightful or terrible.
2 To sound.

(ई) घुरी r. 4th cl. (घुर्य्यते)
1 To be ignorant.
2 To inquire.

(इ) घूरी r. 4th cl. (घूर्य्यते)
1 To kill, to hurt or injure.
2 To become old, to decay.

m. (-रः)
A kind of worm burrowing in the skin, guinea worm, Dracunculus.
f. (-री)
The mole cricket.
f. (-रा)
Growling, as of dog or cat.
E.
घुर् imitative sound, and घुर to sound, with क aff.

r. 1st and 6th cls. (घूर्णते, घूर्णति)
To roll, to whirl, to turn round.

m. (-र्णः)
1 A kind of potherb, (Chironia centauroides): see ग्रीष्मसुन्दरक.
2 Turning round, whirling, rolling, &c.
E.
घूर्ण to roll, affix अच्.

n. (-र्नं)
Revolving, whirling, turning round.
E.
घूर्ण to whirl, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-नः-ना-नं)
Whirling, revolving, rolling, tossing.
E.
घूर्ण, and शानच् aff.

f. (-र्णिः)
Rolling, revolving, going round or over.
E.
घूर्ण, and इन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Rolling, turning, tossing.
E.
घूर्ण to turn round, affix क्त.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Agitated, set in motion, made to go round.
E.
घूर्ण to revolve, pass. voice, शानच् affix; also घूर्णमान middle voice.
